Salaries and expenses, public buildings and grounds in the District of Columbia and adjacent area: For an additional amount, fiscal year 1947, for “Salaries and expenses, public buildings and grounds in the District of Columbia and adjacent area”, $2,700,000.
Equipment, National Archives Building: For additional equipment, National Archives Building, $80,000.

fable.w: This section only appropriates additional funds for salaries, expenses, and equipment for federal buildings. A tempting reading might treat the word "public" in "public buildings" as signalling public involvement, but it is merely part of an appropriation account title. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given any role in a federal decision.
fable.s: For an additional amount, fiscal year 1947, for “Salaries and expenses, public buildings and grounds in the District of Columbia and adjacent area”, $2,700,000.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard appropriations provision authorizing specific sums of money for salaries, expenses, and equipment. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or participation with entities outside the federal government. It merely allocates funds for internal government operations.
qwen_block.s: Salaries and expenses, public buildings and grounds in the District of Columbia and adjacent area: For an additional amount, fiscal year 1947, for “Salaries and expenses, public buildings and grounds in the District of Columbia and adjacent area”, $2,700,000. Equipment, National Archives Building: For additional equipment, National Archives Building, $80,000.

opus.w: The section only provides extra funding for public buildings and grounds in D.C. and for equipment at the National Archives Building. It does not involve anyone outside the federal government in any federal decision, and it has no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. Like Example 1, it is a plain funding provision.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard appropriations provision authorizing funds for salaries, expenses, and equipment for federal buildings. It does not require or recommend any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. The definition of participation requires involvement of non-federal entities in a decision-making process, which is absent here.
qwen_chat.s: Salaries and expenses, public buildings and grounds in the District of Columbia and adjacent area: For an additional amount, fiscal year 1947, for “Salaries and expenses, public buildings and grounds in the District of Columbia and adjacent area”, $2,700,000. Equipment, National Archives Building: For additional equipment, National Archives Building, $80,000.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "public buildings and grounds" implies public access or participation, but the text is strictly an appropriation clause for salaries, expenses, and equipment. It does not mandate any consultation, hearing, or interaction with non-federal entities. The actors involved are entirely within the federal government (appropriations for federal buildings and staff).
